description: Capability and prompting profiles for checkpoints, text encoders, VAEs and adapters referenced by workflow routes.

models.name: Moody Anima Mix v1.0
models.description: Civitai Moody Anima Mix v1.0 checkpoint. The model metadata describes a merged fast-generation/high-resolution Anima mix and marks it as NSFW-capable.

known_limits: No dedicated Blue Archive or NIKKE identity adapter is bundled; route those explicit domains to their specialized workflows.

validation.scope: Anima checkpoint in named API graph

models.name: Qwen 3 0.6B Anima text encoder
models.description: Official Anima Qwen 3 0.6B text encoder dependency shared by the retained Moody Anima Mix comparison route and the official Anima Turbo routes.

models.name: Qwen image VAE for Anima
models.description: Official Qwen image VAE dependency for Anima model graphs.

models.name: Moody Desire Mix v3.0
models.description: Installed general anime/portrait checkpoint for a low-step Flux.2/Klein graph.

capabilities.reference_control: latent img2img only when paired with LoadImage and VAEEncode

notes: This checkpoint is intended for concise visual descriptions rather than SDXL tag recipes.

known_limits: Do not route SDXL/Pony/Illustrious LoRAs to this checkpoint.

validation.visual_fidelity: not benchmarked as a general identity or style metric

models.name: Qwen 3 8B FP8 mixed text encoder
models.description: Text encoder paired with the installed Moody Desire Flux.2/Klein workflow.

capabilities.character_identity: conditioning support only; not a character adapter

notes: Prompt behavior is bounded by the checkpoint and graph; this component is not independently routable.

models.name: Qwen 3 8B full-precision text encoder
models.description: Optional highest-precision text encoder asset installed for explicit high-precision experiments; it is not selected by the generic route.

capabilities.character_identity: conditioning support only; not a character adapter

notes: Requires a graph binding this filename explicitly; the default graph retains the FP8 mixed encoder to preserve generic VRAM headroom.

known_limits: The full encoder and the Moody checkpoint together may exceed a 24 GB device once runtime overhead and the 1 GB headroom target are included.

probes.error: CUDA out of memory during dynamic weight transfer

validation.deployment_limit: Not routeable in the default generic GPU route; explicit CPU text-encoder placement succeeded but is slower.

models.name: Flux.2 VAE
models.description: Decoder used by the installed Flux.2/Klein workflow.

models.name: Animagine XL 3.1
models.description: Anime-focused SDXL checkpoint used by the NIKKE and Blue Archive style routes.

capabilities.character_identity: base style; identity normally comes from tags or an adapter

notes: Use the adapter profile to supply identity and series-specific trigger hints.

known_limits: Pony-only and Illustrious-only adapters require a separate compatible route.

validation.visual_fidelity: not benchmarked as a general identity or style metric

models.name: NIKKE Goddess of Victory Concept — Animagine/SDXL
models.description: NIKKE profile adapter intended to establish the series visual vocabulary.

notes: Place the trigger with the series and character tags; the adapter does not select a character by itself.

known_limits: Strength and fidelity vary across non-Animagine SDXL checkpoints.

models.name: NIKKE Rapi — Pony/SDXL-shaped adapter
models.description: Rapi character adapter currently aliased into the Animagine workflow.

capabilities.identity_strength: character-specific when the correct trigger is used

prompting.dialect: Danbooru-style tags with one outfit trigger
notes: Choose one outfit trigger; do not combine all outfit triggers in one request.

known_limits: This is not a legacy SD 1.5 Rapi adapter; identity fidelity on Animagine is not guaranteed.

validation.visual_fidelity: cross-family compatibility is empirical, not a benchmark

models.name: Blue Archive Game CG Style — Animagine3.1 LoCon
models.description: Style adapter for bright flat-color Blue Archive-like game CG; it is not a character identity adapter.

notes: The published Animagine3.1 variant specifies no trigger word; adjust strength rather than adding one.

known_limits: The source training notes warn that compatibility with other bases can be limited.

validation.visual_fidelity: style route only; exact character fidelity requires a character adapter or stronger base

models.name: Illustrious XL v0.1
models.description: Illustrious XL v0.1 SDXL checkpoint used by the Blue Archive character-identity route.

capabilities.character_identity: base model; identity is supplied by a compatible character LoRA
capabilities.outfit_strength: strong through compatible adapters and tags

notes: Use the matching character adapter's trained words; do not use Animagine-only or Pony-only trigger recipes.

known_limits: Do not mix Illustrious-only adapters into Animagine or Pony routes.

validation.visual_fidelity: base style observed; identity fidelity is adapter- and prompt-dependent

models.name: Asuna Ichinose — Blue Archive 4 outfits [IllustriousXL]
models.description: Character adapter for Asuna Ichinose with four documented outfit tag blocks.

capabilities.outfit_strength: strong when one documented outfit block is selected

prompting.dialect: Illustrious XL tags with 1chn identity token and one outfit block
notes: Use 1chn once and select one outfit block. The model card documents the trained words as tags rather than separate named trigger tokens.

known_limits: Do not load this adapter in the Animagine or Pony routes; use the dedicated Illustrious workflow.

validation.visual_fidelity: Asuna identity was visually observed in the SFW text probe; image-to-image probe was load/path validation at 1 step

models.name: IPAdapter Plus Face — SDXL ViT-H
models.description: Official IPAdapter Plus Face SDXL adapter selected for face-centric reference conditioning without InsightFace or a FaceID LoRA.

capabilities.reference_scope: face-centric reference; not a pixel-locked identity recognizer
capabilities.identity_strength: medium for a clear single-face portrait

notes: Describe the requested character, outfit, pose and scene in the prompt; the face reference is an additional face-centric conditioning signal.

known_limits: This Plus Face adapter is not FaceID; it does not use InsightFace embeddings and may still change identity, hair or expression when the prompt conflicts with the reference.

validation.visual_fidelity: Not established until an SFW route probe completes; the API exposes the adapter's documented conditioning scope rather than promising exact likeness.

models.name: CLIP Vision ViT-H — IPAdapter SDXL dependency
models.description: Matching CLIP Vision ViT-H encoder used by the IPAdapter Unified Loader face preset.

known_limits: This is a dependency of the face route, not a standalone image-generation model.

models.name: Xinsir ControlNet OpenPose SDXL 1.0
models.description: SDXL OpenPose ControlNet used to stabilize body orientation, pose and multi-limb composition while the prompt controls character and scene.

capabilities.pose_strength: strong when the source image yields a usable human skeleton
capabilities.composition_strength: strong for body pose and orientation

notes: Use the control image for pose and orientation. Keep the prompt responsible for character identity, outfit, expression and scene.

known_limits: OpenPose does not control clothing details, face identity or depth; detection quality depends on the supplied source image and the preprocessor.

validation.visual_fidelity: Not established until an SFW route probe completes; control success means graph execution and pose-conditioning plumbing, not exact character likeness.

models.name: comfyui_controlnet_aux OpenPose preprocessor
models.description: Pinned OpenPose preprocessing node that turns a supplied source/control image into an OpenPose map before ControlNet application. Its body/hand/face weights are downloaded and cached by the node on first use.

known_limits: Preprocessor weights are cached under the pinned custom node; a first request may download them and take longer.

models.name: Official Anima Turbo v1.1
models.description: Official CircleStone Labs Anima Turbo v1.1 diffusion checkpoint. This is the highest-precision published Turbo file in the official Anima repository; it is kept as a separate route from Moody for direct comparison.

capabilities.identity_strength: weak-to-medium from prompt; no identity adapter bundled
capabilities.precision_scope: BF16 diffusion weights; shared Qwen text encoder and Qwen image VAE are separate dependencies

prompting.dialect: ordered natural-language description with optional Danbooru-style tags
notes: The official model card documents both tag and caption training; use lowercase tags and keep subject count/identity near the beginning.

known_limits: Turbo is distilled for 8-12 steps at CFG 1 and trades some diversity for stability; it is not a character-specific checkpoint.

validation.scope: official Anima Turbo v1.1 checkpoint in named API graph

models.name: Anima IP-Adapter Character Reference v10
models.description: Anima-specific SigLIP2 IPAdapter checkpoint for face/character reference conditioning. It is used by the Anima Turbo face-reference route and is not interchangeable with SDXL IPAdapter weights.

capabilities.reference_scope: face/character portrait reference with whole-image SigLIP2 encoding; not FaceID
capabilities.identity_strength: medium for a clear single-face portrait

prompting.dialect: detailed Anima-compatible natural language or ordered anime tags
notes: Use a clear single-person portrait. The adapter is reference conditioning, not a prompt replacement and not a pixel-locked face recognizer.

known_limits: Requires the pinned Anima IPAdapter custom node and SigLIP2 encoder; do not use SDXL IPAdapter nodes or FaceID assumptions.

validation.scope: Anima Turbo IPAdapter face-reference named API graph

models.name: SigLIP2 base patch16 512 — Anima IPAdapter vision encoder
models.description: SigLIP2 vision encoder used to convert the supplied face/character reference into Anima IPAdapter tokens. It is loaded separately from the Anima diffusion model.

capabilities.reference_scope: whole-image visual embedding for Anima IPAdapter

known_limits: This is a route dependency, not a standalone image-generation model.

validation.scope: SigLIP2 local load for Anima IPAdapter
